VoiceInfo.description: Present on an audio file recorded as a voice message. Such a file is an ordinary audio/mp4 (AAC in MP4, m4a) attachment, so clients that ignore this field show a downloadable audio file. Uploading with `voice` accepts audio/mp4, audio/m4a, audio/x-m4a or audio/aac with an .m4a, .mp4 or .aac name, at most 15 MiB, always as one upload (never multipart); the stored MIME becomes audio/mp4, and a presigned PUT must send that Content-Type. Completion rejects content that is not an audio-only MP4 and replaces `duration_ms` with the duration read from the container (the claim may differ by at most max(1.5 s, 10 %)). A voice file must be the only file of its message.

waveform.description: 64 peak levels, 0 silent to 255 loudest, each the loudest sample of an equal slice of the recording. Fixed length keeps the payload small (well under 300 bytes of JSON) and lets every client draw the same bars at any width by grouping or stretching.

ScheduledMessageFailureReason.description: Why the message was not sent; the text stays so it can be scheduled again. author_inactive: the account was deactivated (reactivation does not revive it). security_reset: the password was changed or reset, an administrator required a new password, the e-mail changed, or every other device was signed out. session_revoked: the device that scheduled or last changed it was removed from the session list, or its refresh token was reused. Signing out on that device itself or a session expiring never stops a scheduled message. missed_send_time: it could not be sent within 15 minutes of its time. chat_unavailable: the chat was archived or deleted. not_member: the author left or was removed. forbidden: the author may no longer write here. reference_unavailable: the reply target, thread or a mentioned member is gone. attachment_unavailable: a file was deleted. invalid_content: the message no longer passes validation. delivery_error: repeated internal errors.
